newsitem.title: USA: Lawmakers set four electric hearings around U.S.
newsitem.headline: Lawmakers set four electric hearings around U.S.

text.p: House lawmakers have scheduled hearings in four U.S. cities in April and May to discuss the opening of power markets to competition, Rep. Dan Schaefer, a Colorado Republican, said Tuesday.
The hearings will be held in Atlanta, Georgia on April 14, Richmond, Virginia on April 18, Chicago, Illinois on May 2, and Dallas, Texas on May 9.

Schaefer, chairman of the House energy and power subcommittee which is looking to break up utility monopolies, said after the hearings his panel would "begin in earnest" to complete work on a bill to overhaul local power markets.
